metadata.title: Expressionist Crowd and Distorted Block Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring a dense crowd of simplified, colorful impasto-painted heads with white circular eyes, set against a black background. The top third is dominated by aggressive, large-scale distorted typography in vibrant red and outlined black styles, creating a sense of urban claustrophobia and raw energy.
coreVisualRelationships: Textural contrast between thick, tactile paint strokes in the crowd and the flat, graphic sharpness of the black background.
Scale tension between the massive, screen-filling letters and the small, repetitive head motifs.
Color blocking where the primary red of the main text anchors the top while a chaotic multi-color palette fills the bottom.
coreInvariants: Simplified head shapes with two white dot eyes
Visible thick paint texture (impasto) on all colored elements
Solid black negative space at the very top and between figures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The crowd occupies the bottom two-thirds of the frame in a dense, overlapping arrangement. The typography dominates the top third, stretching across the full width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bright red block lettering on the top left acts as the primary focal point due to its scale and color intensity.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large red text, moves right across the secondary distorted text, then descends into the rhythmic pattern of the colorful heads.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black space is used at the top margin and as a fill within the secondary text block to provide high-contrast separation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black provides the foundational negative space and structural outlines.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant Red is used for the primary display typography to command attention.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: A diverse palette of primary and secondary colors (blue, yellow, green, teal, purple) defines the individual heads.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all colors, contrasted against a zero-value black background for maximum pop.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text: Massive, blocky, vertically elongated with rough, scratched-in textures.
Secondary text: Outlined, interlocking, and warped to fit a rectangular block, using varying widths and sharp angles.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are squeezed and stretched to eliminate gaps between them.
Internal textures within the red letters mimic woodcut or dry-brush strokes.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, textured solid block font paired with a lighter, outlined, warped geometric style.

preserve: The vertical elongation of the primary text
The interlocking nature of the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight for the primary display text.
Matches the warped, interlocking style of the secondary text block.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an oil painting style image of a dense crowd of simple, colorful heads with white dot eyes. Use thick impasto texture. The top third of the image should be solid black.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, vertically stretched, textured red block lettering on the top left. On the top right, add a block of interlocking, outlined, warped text in a geometric style.

verificationChecks: Is the paint texture thick and visible?
Are the eyes simple white circles?
Is the text heavily distorted and filling the top third?

mustRedesign: Exact letter shapes of the original branding
Specific arrangement of the colored heads
postGenerationChecks: Confirm the impasto texture is present on all colored elements.
Ensure the text is integrated into the black background without soft glows.
Check that the crowd fills the bottom two-thirds completely.
Verify the white eyes are distinct and high-contrast.
